people.name: Dominic J. Olivo
people.story: Founder of Olivo Foods (frozen Italian specialties, sold to Northline Foods in 2014). Widowed 2008; remarried 2011. Still chairs the foundation; drives the cars.

people.name: Marguerite Meloni Olivo
people.story: Dominic's second wife; former gallery director. Prenuptial agreement; provided for through the 2019 SLAT.

people.name: Anthony D. Olivo
people.story: Eldest. Ran Olivo Foods' operations through the sale; chairs the family office and sits on the Dynasty Trust distribution committee.

people.name: Dr. Elena Olivo
people.story: Anthony's wife; interventional cardiologist at a Stamford hospital.

people.name: Francesca Olivo-Cipolla
people.story: Middle child. Contemporary-art dealer with a gallery in Miami; advises the family's art holdings.

people.name: Michael T. Olivo
people.story: Youngest of the first marriage. Venture investor in San Francisco (GP of Caldera Ventures). Divorced 2021.

people.name: Giulia Olivo
people.story: Dominic and Marguerite's daughter. Minor; assets held in a 2503(c) trust.

people.name: Theresa Zucchini Olivo
people.story: Dominic's first wife, mother of Anthony, Francesca and Michael. Died 2008; her estate funded the Theresa Olivo Family Trust.

people.name: Claire Porcari
people.story: Michael's former wife (divorced 2021), Theo's mother; shared custody. Not a client — contact for Theo's trust and school matters only.
